description.en: The cycle of the scheduled fix. Unit: day.

description.zh:
镜像定时修复开关。

- **on**：打开。
- **off**：关闭。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the schedule image fix.

- **on**: enable

- **off**: disable

description.zh:
镜像定时修复的范围。该参数为JSON格式，包含以下字段：

- **type**：目标类型，固定为repo
- **target**：目标内容，格式：命名空间/镜像仓
description.en:
The range of the scheduled fix. The value of this parameter is in the JSON format and contains the following fields:

- **type**: The type of the image. The value is fixed to repo.

- **target**: The content of the image. The value is in the format of Namespace/Image repository.

description.zh: 镜像有过修改的时间范围。单位，天。
description.en: The time range during which the image was modified. Unit: day.

title.zh: 修改镜像定时修复配置
